crossRefs.note: He said, “Please, my brothers, don’t act so wickedly.
The man, the master of the house, went out to them, and said to them, “No, my brothers, please don’t act so wickedly…
He said, “Brothers and fathers, listen. The God of glory appeared to our father Abraham when he was in Mesopotamia…
“Brothers and fathers, listen to the defense which I now make to you.”
David inquired of Yahweh, saying, “If I pursue after this troop, will I overtake them?” He answered him, “Pursue; for…
Yahweh makes poor and makes rich. He brings low, he also lifts up.
They said to Moses, “Your servants have taken the sum of the men of war who are under our command, and there lacks not…
You shall eat and be full, and you shall bless Yahweh your God for the good land which he has given you.
But you shall remember Yahweh your God, for it is he who gives you power to get wealth, that he may establish his…
Both riches and honor come from you, and you rule over all! In your hand is power and might! It is in your hand to make…
Therefore he sacrifices to his net, and burns incense to his dragnet, because by them his life is luxurious, and his…
You drove out the nations with your hand, but you planted them. You afflicted the peoples, but you spread them abroad.
Yahweh will keep you from all evil. He will keep your soul.
Yahweh will keep your going out and your coming in, from this time forward, and forever more.

people.name: David
people.line: Anointed king of Israel, ancestor of Jesus Christ

translations.web: Then David said, “Do not do so, my brothers, with that which Yahweh has given to us, who has preserved us, and delivered the troop that came against us into our hand.
translations.bsb: But David said, “My brothers, you must not do this with what the LORD has given us. He has protected us and delivered into our hands the raiders who came against us.
translations.kjv: Then said David, Ye shall not do so, my brethren, with that which the LORD hath given us, who hath preserved us, and delivered the company that came against us into our hand.
translations.asv: Then said David, Ye shall not do so, my brethren, with that which Jehovah hath given unto us, who hath preserved us, and delivered the troop that came against us into our hand.
